notes:
- **Find something to watch — your own AI pick list.** A new section in the
  sidebar suggests great titles you don't own yet, chosen from what you've rated
  — each with a poster, a synopsis and a one-line reason it thinks you'll like
  it. Choose what you're in the mood for at the top — Movie, Series, Anime or
  Documentary — flip on any genres you fancy, and add a hint like "something
  like Inception" if you want; it blends all three into the picks. Tap "Find it"
  and it drops you into Add media already searching the right tracker for that
  title, so you can grab it in a couple of clicks. "Load more" fetches a fresh
  batch, and the more you rate, the sharper the picks get.
